patent.title: 变量柱塞泵的控制方法、装置及变量柱塞泵
assignees: 广东科达液压技术有限公司
patent.family_note: Ordinary CN mechanical invention (Guangdong Keda Hydraulic / mid-tier industrial hydraulics; not software, not BYD/Huawei/award-star). Parent-group sibling risk: 广东科达洁能 CN106194680A/B「一种变量柱塞泵及其控制方法」(2016) — do not inherit product narrative from parent patents. Current assignee renamed from 佛山市科达液压机械有限公司 (CP01 2021-12-07). Public product catalogs list K4VSO/K10VSO variable pumps without naming this grant number. 2018 HKZM Bridge company story names other invention/utility filings, not this 2019 grant. No PP01 observed on reviewed legal-status timeline (CP01 only) — PP01≠R/RC rule still applies generally.

knowledge_origin.description: Public sources confirm Foshan/Guangdong Keda Hydraulic inventorship/assignee for this variable-piston-pump control filing, but do not reconstruct whether it originated as an internal electro-proportional control cost-down track versus a named product-roadmap SKU feature for K4VSO/K10VSO families.

technology.problem: Conventional electro-proportional variable piston pumps add displacement sensors, amplifiers and related components to achieve electrical proportional control, raising cost and complexity.
technology.mechanism: Claimed method/apparatus/pump: flow valve set via spring between electromagnet and cylinder feedback rod; after electromagnet energizes, oil pushes the valve's variable rod to compress the spring so spring force feeds back to the electromagnet for closed-loop displacement control without a displacement sensor. Optional pressure valve reduces displacement above a pressure threshold; optional power valve implements hyperbolic power limiting via lever feedback.
technology.comparison_baseline: Electro-proportional variable axial piston pumps that rely on displacement sensor + amplifier + proportional valve chains (as described in the patent background).
